beat_1.title: The Awakening
beat_1.beat_1_wake.speaker: Narrator
beat_1.beat_1_wake.line_0: Grey sky. Cold sand. The taste of salt and copper.
beat_1.beat_1_wake.line_1: No name. No memory of the sea. Only a hollow where something should have been.
beat_1.beat_1_wake.line_2: The wreckage of a ship litters the shore. The drowned crew lie where the tide left them.
beat_1.beat_1_darius.speaker: Darius
beat_1.beat_1_darius.line_1: That makes two of us the sea didn't want.
beat_1.beat_1_darius.npc.name: Darius
beat_1.beat_1_bria.speaker: Bria
beat_1.beat_1_bria.line_0: This is the Shore of Camelot. You came in with the wreckage, {playerName} - and the dead.
beat_1.beat_1_bria.line_1: The pale arches up the rise are the old Colosseum ruins. My roof. Broth and bandages, if you can walk to them.
beat_1.beat_1_bria.line_2: But the road there is not clean. Something has been coming down off the cliffs at dusk.
beat_1.beat_1_bria.npc.name: Bria
beat_1.beat_1_choice.speaker: Bria
beat_1.beat_1_choice.line_0: So. How do you mean to reach my door, {playerName}?
beat_1.beat_1_choice.option_0.text: [Fight] Head-on. Whatever comes, I put it down.
beat_1.beat_1_choice.option_1.text: [Sneak] Quietly. No sense feeding the dark.
beat_1.beat_1_choice.npc.name: Bria
beat_1.beat_1_resolve_fight.speaker: Darius
beat_1.beat_1_resolve_fight.npc.name: Darius
beat_1.beat_1_resolve_sneak.speaker: Darius
beat_1.beat_1_resolve_sneak.line_2: It finds us anyway. It always does.
beat_1.beat_1_resolve_sneak.npc.name: Darius
beat_10.title: The Undead Army
beat_10.beat_10_arrival.speaker: Narrator
beat_10.beat_10_arrival.line_0: The plain before the tower is not empty. It is standing.
beat_10.beat_10_arrival.line_1: Skeletons in rusted mail. Bloated dead that were farmers a season ago. Row upon row, and at their head, a crown of bone.
beat_10.beat_10_arrival.line_2: This is the dominion Daverak promised. This is who keeps it.
beat_10.beat_10_kyarias.speaker: Kyarias
beat_10.beat_10_kyarias.line_0: The little ant has reached the throne. All games end.
beat_10.beat_10_kyarias.line_1: I am Kyarias. My lord Daverak keeps the tower; I keep the ground before it, and everything under it.
beat_10.beat_10_kyarias.line_2: Every soul that falls joins my ranks. Yours will make fine additions.
beat_10.beat_10_kyarias.npc.name: Kyarias
beat_10.beat_10_party.speaker: Tywin
beat_10.beat_10_party.line_0: That's a great many of them, my good sir.
beat_10.beat_10_party.line_1: Darius: Then we make it a great many fewer.
beat_10.beat_10_party.line_2: Tywin: ...I do like a man with a plan. Shoulder to shoulder, {playerName}.
beat_10.beat_10_party.npc.name: Tywin
beat_10.beat_10_combat.enemy_0.name: Kyarias
beat_10.beat_10_combat.enemy_1.name: Skeleton Warrior
beat_10.beat_10_combat.enemy_2.name: Skeleton Warrior
beat_10.beat_10_combat.enemy_3.name: Skeleton Warrior
beat_10.beat_10_combat.enemy_4.name: Skeleton Warrior
beat_10.beat_10_combat.enemy_5.name: Skeleton Warrior
beat_10.beat_10_combat.enemy_6.name: Rotting Zombie
beat_10.beat_10_combat.enemy_7.name: Rotting Zombie
beat_10.beat_10_combat.enemy_8.name: Rotting Zombie
beat_10.beat_10_combat.enemy_9.name: Rotting Zombie
beat_10.beat_10_combat.enemy_10.name: Rotting Zombie
beat_10.beat_10_combat.ally_0.name: Darius
beat_10.beat_10_combat.ally_1.name: Tywin
beat_10.beat_10_victory.speaker: Darius
beat_10.beat_10_victory.line_0: The crown of bone goes still. The army with it. Ash on the wind, like the hounds on the shore.
beat_10.beat_10_victory.line_1: The tower is still standing, {playerName}. This was the gate. Not the throne.
beat_10.beat_10_victory.line_2: You spoke a name in your sleep once. I think the thing in that tower knows it. I think, soon, so will you.
beat_10.beat_10_victory.npc.name: Darius
beat_2.title: The Tavern
beat_2.beat_2_enter.speaker: Bria
beat_2.beat_2_enter.line_0: In. Sit. You've the look of the drowned about you, {playerName} - sit before you fall.
beat_2.beat_2_enter.line_1: This is what's left of the Rusty Tankard. Half a roof and honest broth. It has kept better folk than you alive.
beat_2.beat_2_enter.line_2: Burgh will see to your friend's cuts. Eat first. Questions after.
beat_2.beat_2_enter.npc.name: Bria
beat_2.beat_2_world.speaker: Bria
beat_2.beat_2_world.line_0: The dusk comes wrong now. Fog off the sea before the sun's even down.
beat_2.beat_2_world.line_1: The shadows are bolder every night. Folk who walk the roads don't come back the same - if they come back.
beat_2.beat_2_world.line_2: It started when the black tower rose in the north. Old men say a name for what sits in it. I won't say it under my own roof.
beat_2.beat_2_world.npc.name: Bria
beat_2.beat_2_darius.speaker: Darius
beat_2.beat_2_darius.line_1: Then we find whatever did this.
beat_2.beat_2_darius.npc.name: Darius
beat_2.beat_2_rest.speaker: Narrator
beat_2.beat_2_rest.line_0: You sleep. For the first time since the sea, the hollow inside you is quiet.
beat_2.beat_2_rest.line_2: At first light, the fog is already at the door. The road north is waiting.
beat_3.title: First Blood
beat_3.beat_3_intro.speaker: Darius
beat_3.beat_3_intro.line_1: Something's out there. It's not afraid of us.
beat_3.beat_3_intro.npc.name: Darius
beat_3.beat_3_warn.speaker: Darius
beat_3.beat_3_warn.line_1: Put them down before they circle.
beat_3.beat_3_warn.npc.name: Darius
beat_3.beat_3_combat.enemy_0.name: Hell Hound Alpha
beat_3.beat_3_combat.enemy_1.name: Hell Hound Beta
beat_3.beat_3_combat.enemy_2.name: Hell Hound Gamma
beat_3.beat_3_combat.ally_0.name: Darius
beat_3.beat_3_after.speaker: Darius
beat_3.beat_3_after.line_1: Nothing that dies like that was ever alive.
beat_3.beat_3_after.line_2: Whatever made them is still up the road.
beat_3.beat_3_after.npc.name: Darius
beat_4.title: The Dark Warrior
beat_4.beat_4_intro.speaker: Dark Warrior
beat_4.beat_4_intro.line_1: No. Of course not. The sea took that from you. I made certain of it.
beat_4.beat_4_intro.line_2: I am the Seeker of Darkness. And you were never meant to reach this shore alive.
beat_4.beat_4_intro.npc.name: Dark Warrior
beat_4.beat_4_defiance.speaker: Darius
beat_4.beat_4_defiance.line_0: I don't remember you. I don't need to.
beat_4.beat_4_defiance.npc.name: Darius
beat_4.beat_4_combat.enemy_0.name: Dariartimous
beat_4.beat_4_combat.ally_0.name: Darius
beat_4.beat_4_vanish.speaker: Dark Warrior
beat_4.beat_4_vanish.line_0: Do you feel it? What you were meant to be?
beat_4.beat_4_vanish.line_1: You are not ready. Not yet.
beat_4.beat_4_vanish.line_2: We will meet again, {playerName} - when the name returns to you.
beat_4.beat_4_vanish.npc.name: Dark Warrior
beat_4.beat_4_burgh.speaker: Burgh
beat_4.beat_4_burgh.line_0: I heard steel out there. Followed the sound. Found these in the scorch where he stood.
beat_4.beat_4_burgh.line_1: Two blades. Good ones. Better than anything you're carrying.
beat_4.beat_4_burgh.line_2: Keep them. Whatever that thing was - you'll need them.
beat_4.beat_4_burgh.npc.name: Burgh
beat_5.title: The Sorcerer
beat_5.beat_5_intro.speaker: Risidian
beat_5.beat_5_intro.line_0: Twice now you've crept up on me. Bold. Or stupid.
beat_5.beat_5_intro.line_1: You wish to harm me? Whatever for?
beat_5.beat_5_intro.line_2: Speak plainly. I have little patience and less time.
beat_5.beat_5_intro.npc.name: Risidian
beat_5.beat_5_choice.speaker: Risidian
beat_5.beat_5_choice.line_0: Well? What is it you seek?
beat_5.beat_5_choice.option_0.text: The tower has poisoned this land. Help us end it.
beat_5.beat_5_choice.option_1.text: Power. Enough to destroy the Black Knight.
beat_5.beat_5_choice.npc.name: Risidian
beat_5.beat_5_plead.speaker: Risidian
beat_5.beat_5_plead.line_1: Nobility is a fine word for a corpse. Still - let us see if your arm is worth your tongue.
beat_5.beat_5_plead.line_2: Raise your blade, then. I'll not make it gentle.
beat_5.beat_5_plead.npc.name: Risidian
beat_5.beat_5_demand.speaker: Risidian
beat_5.beat_5_demand.line_1: That? You won't find it here. Move on.
beat_5.beat_5_demand.line_2: But you won't, will you. Very well. Take it from me if you can.
beat_5.beat_5_demand.npc.name: Risidian
beat_5.beat_5_combat.enemy_0.name: Risidian
beat_5.beat_5_combat.ally_0.name: Darius
beat_5.beat_5_depart.speaker: Risidian
beat_5.beat_5_depart.line_0: Enough. You have earned a truth, if not my aid.
beat_5.beat_5_depart.line_1: What you hunt is no knight. It is older than the tower it sits in, and it knows your face, {playerName}.
beat_5.beat_5_depart.line_2: Go north. And do try to be worth the trouble you have cost me.
beat_5.beat_5_depart.npc.name: Risidian
beat_6.title: Lore of the Shadow
beat_6.beat_6_vision.speaker: Narrator
beat_6.beat_6_vision.line_0: That night the hollow inside you fills - not with memory, but with a dream that is not yours.
beat_6.beat_6_vision.line_1: A storm cliff. The world ending over a black sea.
beat_6.beat_6_vision.line_2: Five weapons torn from the dark and driven into the stone: a meteoric hammer, a sword wreathed in flame, a moonlit spear, a great two-handed blade, a pair of bone daggers.
beat_6.beat_6_vision.line_3: A seal carved in ruin. The castle woke - and the world knew something terrible had begun.
beat_6.beat_6_ritual.speaker: Dariartimous
beat_6.beat_6_ritual.line_0: The seal is set, my lord. The five are given.
beat_6.beat_6_ritual.npc.name: Dariartimous
beat_6.beat_6_daverak.speaker: Daverak
beat_6.beat_6_daverak.line_0: Thy loyalty draws nigh its proving, Seeker.
beat_6.beat_6_daverak.line_1: The prophecy is not silent. One is born who at his eighteenth year may sunder me. Atriartous. That is the name the stars have carved.
beat_6.beat_6_daverak.line_2: Only one can sunder me. See that he is undone - before he knows what he is.
beat_6.beat_6_daverak.npc.name: Daverak
beat_6.beat_6_decree.speaker: Dariartimous
beat_6.beat_6_decree.line_0: It shall be done, my lord.
beat_6.beat_6_decree.line_1: A ship crosses the northern water tonight. The boy is aboard it.
beat_6.beat_6_decree.line_2: The sea will take him. And with him, every memory of the name you fear.
beat_6.beat_6_decree.npc.name: Dariartimous
beat_6.beat_6_wake.speaker: Darius
beat_6.beat_6_wake.line_0: You were talking in your sleep. A name.
beat_6.beat_6_wake.line_1: You didn't recognise it. I could tell.
beat_6.beat_6_wake.line_2: The sea didn't take everything. Remember the rest, and we'll know what we're walking toward.
beat_6.beat_6_wake.npc.name: Darius
beat_7.title: Journey Begins
beat_7.beat_7_scout.speaker: Scout
beat_7.beat_7_scout.line_0: Don't go on - the woods are crawling. They've set a trap.
beat_7.beat_7_scout.line_1: Six of them, at least. Goblins, but wrong. Hungry the way the fog is hungry.
beat_7.beat_7_scout.line_2: There's a game trail east if you want to slip past. Your call, strangers.
beat_7.beat_7_scout.npc.name: Scout
beat_7.beat_7_choice.speaker: Darius
beat_7.beat_7_choice.line_0: Six of them. They think numbers are enough.
beat_7.beat_7_choice.line_1: Trail, or teeth. Say the word.
beat_7.beat_7_choice.option_0.text: Take the trail. Hit them from where they aren't looking.
beat_7.beat_7_choice.npc.name: Darius
beat_7.beat_7_flank.speaker: Darius
beat_7.beat_7_flank.line_1: We take the trail. They'll never hear us.
beat_7.beat_7_flank.line_2: Then they hear everything at once.
beat_7.beat_7_flank.npc.name: Darius
beat_7.beat_7_charge.speaker: Darius
beat_7.beat_7_charge.line_1: Everything hungry crawls out of it.
beat_7.beat_7_charge.line_2: So we make more room. Go.
beat_7.beat_7_charge.npc.name: Darius
beat_7.beat_7_combat.enemy_0.name: Goblin Raider
beat_7.beat_7_combat.enemy_1.name: Goblin Raider
beat_7.beat_7_combat.enemy_2.name: Goblin Raider
beat_7.beat_7_combat.enemy_3.name: Goblin Archer
beat_7.beat_7_combat.enemy_4.name: Goblin Archer
beat_7.beat_7_combat.enemy_5.name: Goblin Warleader
beat_7.beat_7_combat.ally_0.name: Darius
beat_8.title: The Knight
beat_8.beat_8_halt.speaker: Tywin
beat_8.beat_8_halt.line_1: Prove you're not one more thing crawling out of the thin places.
beat_8.beat_8_halt.line_2: Tywin of the Round Table. Sixteen years and still breathing, which out here is a boast. Draw, or turn back.
beat_8.beat_8_halt.npc.name: Tywin
beat_8.beat_8_choice.speaker: Tywin
beat_8.beat_8_choice.option_0.text: We're no shadow. But if a blade is the only word you trust - so be it.
beat_8.beat_8_choice.npc.name: Tywin
beat_8.beat_8_words.speaker: Tywin
beat_8.beat_8_words.line_1: But the fog wears honest faces too. So - forgive me.
beat_8.beat_8_words.line_2: One pass. Show me. Then we'll talk like men.
beat_8.beat_8_words.npc.name: Tywin
beat_8.beat_8_steel.speaker: Tywin
beat_8.beat_8_steel.line_2: Rapier's already out, my good sir.
beat_8.beat_8_steel.npc.name: Tywin
beat_8.beat_8_combat.enemy_0.name: Tywin
beat_8.beat_8_combat.ally_0.name: Darius
beat_8.beat_8_yield.speaker: Tywin
beat_8.beat_8_yield.line_0: Enough - you've made your point, my good sir.
beat_8.beat_8_yield.line_1: Good. Most don't last this long. Most aren't worth the road.
beat_8.beat_8_yield.line_2: You are. So I'll walk it with you a while - if only to see how it ends.
beat_8.beat_8_yield.npc.name: Tywin
beat_9.title: Joint Forces
beat_9.beat_9_join.speaker: Tywin
beat_9.beat_9_join.line_0: Two swords are better than one, my good sir.
beat_9.beat_9_join.line_1: And I'll be honest - I'd prefer not to die alone.
beat_9.beat_9_join.line_2: Whatever that is on the ridge, it's ours now. Together.
beat_9.beat_9_join.npc.name: Tywin
beat_9.beat_9_demon.speaker: Tauros
beat_9.beat_9_demon.line_0: Thirteen feet of horn and hate, and it smells you on the wind.
beat_9.beat_9_demon.line_1: Ember eyes. A greataxe the size of a door. A hide that has turned every blade ever raised against it.
beat_9.beat_9_demon.line_2: It does not speak. It only lowers its horns.
beat_9.beat_9_demon.npc.name: Tauros
beat_9.beat_9_plan.speaker: Tywin
beat_9.beat_9_plan.line_0: Its hide turns steel - go for the joints! The legs, {playerName}, buy Darius the opening!
beat_9.beat_9_plan.line_1: Darius: The head. Get me to the head.
beat_9.beat_9_plan.line_2: Tywin: Then keep it looking at me. NOW - KILL IT!
beat_9.beat_9_plan.npc.name: Tywin
beat_9.beat_9_combat.enemy_0.name: Tauros
beat_9.beat_9_combat.ally_0.name: Darius
beat_9.beat_9_combat.ally_1.name: Tywin
beat_9.beat_9_after.speaker: Tywin
beat_9.beat_9_after.line_0: The axe goes over the cliff. Good riddance. That was messy.
beat_9.beat_9_after.line_1: Still glad you didn't want to die alone, my good sir?
beat_9.beat_9_after.npc.name: Tywin
exploration_demo.title: Exploration Demo
exploration_demo.demo_intro.speaker: Warden
exploration_demo.demo_intro.line_0: Stop! The gate ahead is locked.
exploration_demo.demo_intro.line_1: Only those who find the secret lever in the cave can pass.
exploration_demo.demo_lever_pulled.line_: You pull the lever. A heavy grinding sound echoes from the forest.
exploration_demo.demo_gate_unlocked.line: The gate is open! You may proceed.
exploration_demo.demo_boss.enemy_0.name: Gate Keeper
